abstract: Assesses bilateral media suites and national delegation ranking surveys
system_message:
You are the Diplomatic protocol officer (DPO), responsible for assessing bilateral media suites, national delegation ranking surveys, and media broadcasting infrastructure across candidate convention centers.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Media broadcasting booths（PRESS）
information_points.content:
DPO-PRESS-DLK：Based on the international press center allocation register, Weser Estuary Exhibition Complex maintains 40 booths configured as accredited international press booths.
DPO-PRESS-4EW：Records from the international press center allocation register confirm that Bremenhaven Atlantic Forum features 32 booths for accredited international press booths.
DPO-PRESS-0Y6：The international press center allocation register shows that North Sea Maritime Congress Center provides 24 booths designated as accredited international press booths.

information_points.title: Assesses bilateral media suites and national delegation ranking surveys（PROTO）
information_points.content:
DPO-PROTO-2CE：Preliminary delegation liaison survey results indicate that Bremenhaven Atlantic Forum attained a delegate satisfaction rating for bilateral suites of 92% among foreign ministry advance teams.
DPO-PROTO-D4N：According to the preliminary delegation liaison survey of participating foreign ministry advance teams, North Sea Maritime Congress Center achieved a delegate satisfaction rating for bilateral suites of 92%.
DPO-PROTO-TQ7：For Weser Estuary Exhibition Complex, the delegate satisfaction rating for bilateral suites recorded across participating foreign ministry advance teams is 96%.
